name: consolation
quote: I lost the match, but her look of pride of helped.
description: Something that adds some relief to a generally negative situation.
perceptions: There was a small aspect of the event that can be seen as positive.

variations.name: thankful consolation
variations.description: If someone provided assistance in the negative situation, it may come with gratitude.
perceptions: Someone did something to help make the outcome not as bad as it could have been.

comparisons.description: A consolation is a small positive amidst a larger negative situation while bittersweet is a roughly equal balance of positive and negative.

commentaries.quote: There was always the consolation that if I didn't like what I wrote I could throw it away or burn it.

When you're in the muck you can only see muck. If you somehow manage to float above it, you still see the muck but you see it from a different perspective. And you see other things too. That's the consolation of philosophy.
